about: The secreta of the formulary “Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed — Mass III” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Whose mercy is boundless, graciously accept our humble prayers, and, through this sacrament of salvation, grant to the souls of all the faithful departed, to whom You gave the grace of believing in You, the remission of all their sins. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
